budget_scope: New standalone project. Earlier projects excluded.

operations.purpose: Warm ivory fine washi fibers for the actual folding crane surface; replace visibly directional procedural fibers only if in-site evaluation improves material.
immutable_constraints: No finished crane or city model
No text, folds, objects, baked lighting, stains or plastic sheen
Evaluate in the real site before deciding on another generation
acceptance_tests: Square image of fine irregular non-directional fibers without objects or text
Warm ivory albedo with low contrast, no directional lighting
Opposite-edge match checked; local technical seam correction allowed
Real site close-up at normal lighting shows subtle paper detail without sparkle or plastic relief
Material works in closed, intermediate and open poses and is not a performance burden
operations.decision: Used by the live crane material. Texture pixel inspection and static actual-WebGL city/close-up inspection completed. Fine fibers are subtle at normal viewing distance. No retry is justified by the available evidence. Continuous motion and representative foreground performance remain unverified.

site_evaluation.scope: Actual WebGL home, three city endpoints and Almaty close-up on Windows Chrome; endpoint inspection is not motion acceptance. Blender five hinge positions and underside detail retained separately.
limitations: No continuous normal-speed browser recording obtained.
Foreground frame timing invalid because the browser was throttled.
Fine fibers are difficult to judge in whole-object screenshots; no reference-level material claim.

operations.charge_evidence: Verified 2.75-credit account-balance delta matches the exact preflight quote. No account balances or provider invoice are published.
